senses.en: a detailed arrangement for what you will do

example.en: Our plan is to leave early tomorrow.
example.zh: 我们的计划是明天早点出发。

senses.en: to decide and arrange what you will do

example.en: We plan to visit the museum on Saturday.
example.zh: 我们打算星期六去参观博物馆。

senses.en: a drawing that shows how something is arranged or built

example.en: The architect showed us a plan of the new house.
example.zh: 建筑师给我们看了新房子的设计图。
